response.sql: WITH tel_avg AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse FROM tel_avg t, overall o WHERE t.avg_pulse > o.overall_avg), second AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS second_avg FROM above_overall), final AS (SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_pulse FROM above_overall a, second s WHERE a.avg_pulse > s.second_avg) SELECT AVG(f.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse, AVG(f.avg_pulse - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.avg_pulse - s.second_avg) AS avg_above_second FROM final f, overall o, second s;
